[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1h7[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]%wait(..., for_epic=): a wait that follows its agent into the epic [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]it launches[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`%wait:planner` waits for the planner and then for every epic bead [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the planner (or any member of its session, clan, workflow, or bound[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]tribe) launches, so users can submit follow-up prompts before the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]epic's ID exists. A per-occurrence `for_epic=true|false` keyword [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]controls the behavior. It defaults to true for user-authored agent [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]targets, and using it without an agent target is a hard error in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the launcher and the editor. The hand-off is recorded reliably, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never deadlocks the epic machinery, and is clearly visible in the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]TUI as a teal `↪` hand-off.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]wait_for_epic.md[/bold #87AFFF]
